title: Tail-period killer and the lcm cone: waves 20-25 of the #249 reduction chain (plus the Farey-gap and unit-gap side lanes)

concepts.label: local totient tail R_N
concepts.description: R_N = sum_{m>=1} phi(N+m)/2^m, the fractional layer of 2^N times the #249 constant S.

concepts.label: shifted tail difference D_h(N)
concepts.description: D_h(N) = R_{N+h} - R_N; rationality of S forces it to be an integer for one h and all large N.

concepts.label: tail-period law
concepts.description: If S = p/q and oddPart(q) divides 2^h - 1 then D_h(N) is an integer for every N >= v2(q).

concepts.label: window discrepancy A_{h,N,L}
concepts.description: Depth-L signed integer truncation of 2^L * D_h(N) built from totient differences.

concepts.label: certifiedKill (endpoint residue certificate)
concepts.description: Decidable claim that A mod 2^L avoids the radius-(N+h+L+2) band around 0, hence D_h(N) is not an integer.

concepts.label: integer carry orbit / survivorKill
concepts.description: Orbit c_{i+1} = 2 c_i - (phi(n+h)-phi(n)) tracking D_h(N+i); a certificate that every box candidate escapes the strip.

concepts.label: periodLcm t = lcm(1..t)
concepts.description: One-parameter universal period family: every primitive period h0 <= t divides it.

concepts.label: lcm cone {k*H_t}
concepts.description: The multiplicative cone of cone points q*H_t on which rationality forces one common fractional part.

concepts.label: cone flatness law
concepts.description: Rationality makes every difference R_{(q+m)H_t} - R_{qH_t} an integer beyond a threshold scale.

concepts.label: coneNonflatCert (menu refuter)
concepts.description: Decidable |Q|^2 check that the one-sided arcs of a finite vertex menu share no common point.

concepts.label: certificate completeness
concepts.description: Some finite depth certifies (h,N) exactly when D_h(N) is a non-integer; certificates are receipts, not a weaker surrogate.

concepts.label: supply hypothesis
concepts.description: A cofinal 'for every threshold there is a firing certificate' assumption; the open content of #249 in every wave of this zone.

concepts.label: dyadic coboundary (2 - E)
concepts.description: a = 2c - Ec; its image has exact prefix/terminal cancellation at every horizon and is stable under finite shift operators.

concepts.label: finite-rank shift algebra
concepts.description: Finite iterated forward differences and finite integer shift polynomials acting on integer sequences.

concepts.label: sparse anchor pulse
concepts.description: Synthetic nonzero orbit that is -A on a sparse anchor set and 0 elsewhere, defeating factor-ideal-only hypotheses.

concepts.label: Moebius totient channel
concepts.description: d-th channel of phi(n) = sum_{d|n} mu(d) (n/d), totalised by zero off the divisor progression.

concepts.label: Farey/mediant gap certificate
concepts.description: Unimodular neighbour bracketing forcing any rational inside a gap to have denominator at least b+d.

concepts.label: reduced-denominator unit-gap certificate
concepts.description: Refinement admitting lattice points in the cleared interval only when all of them are nonunits mod the odd reduced denominator.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Two-to-the-N times the #249 constant splits exactly as an integer prefix plus the local totient tail: 2^N * sum_n phi(n)/2^n = Phi_N + R_N, where Phi_N is a finite integer sum and R_N = sum_{m>=1} phi(N+m)/2^m converges.
statement_nodes.engine: geometric-linear majorant (phi(n) <= n) plus tsum splitting
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: The standard base-2 prefix/tail split of a convergent binary-weighted series; no new content beyond bookkeeping.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: The local totient tail satisfies 0 < R_M <= M + 2 and the exact carry recurrence R_{M+1} = 2 R_M - phi(M+1); consequently every shifted tail difference is trapped in the open strip |R_{N+h} - R_N| < N + h + 2, and at any depth L the difference equals a signed increment prefix plus 2^{-L} times the translated difference.
statement_nodes.engine: phi(n) <= n against a geometric-linear majorant; telescoping of the doubling map
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Elementary: the doubling recurrence is the binary shift map, the strip bound is phi(n) <= n plus a geometric series.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: If the #249 constant equals a rational r whose denominator divides 2^N (2^h - 1) then R_{N+h} - R_N is an integer; hence if the constant is not irrational there exist h >= 1 and N0 such that every shifted tail difference at period h from N0 on is an integer. This converts irrationality of the series into non-integrality of some shifted tail difference.
statement_nodes.engine: Euler's theorem: the multiplicative order of 2 modulo the odd part of the denominator supplies the period
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is the classical 'rational iff eventually periodic binary expansion' fact with the pre-period given by v2(den) and the period by ord_2 of the odd part; only the packaging in terms of R_N is local.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: If the residue of the depth-L window discrepancy A_{h,N,L} modulo 2^L avoids the radius-(N+h+L+2) neighbourhood of 0, then R_{N+h} - R_N is not an integer.
statement_nodes.engine: truncate at depth L, bound the deep tail by (M+L+2)/2^L, compare with the integer residue band
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Standard 'residue outside the error band forces non-integrality' argument; the content is the explicit one-sided tail bound.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Conversely, if R_{N+h} - R_N is a non-integer then some finite depth L certifies it. So an endpoint certificate exists at (h,N) exactly when the tail difference is non-integral; the same equivalence holds cell by cell on the lcm diagonal.
statement_nodes.engine: distance-to-nearest-integer delta > 0, then choose depth with 2(N+h+L+2) < delta*2^L
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: RESTATEMENT (per-cell). Both sides of the equivalence are, for a general (h,N), unresolved: 'some depth certifies (h,N)' and 'R_{N+h} - R_N is a non-integer' are two names for the same open per-cell question, and by tail_diff_mem_int_iff_scaled_series_mem_int the right-hand side is exactly non-integrality of 2^N (2^h - 1) S. The theorem decides no cell; it only shows the finite certificate is not a lossy surrogate. Flagged as a restatement because it is a change of coordinates between two open statements, at the level of a single cell rather than of #249 as a whole; the zone-level restatement is certificate_supply_is_equivalent_to_249, and this node is what makes that one true. Adversarial-review note (2026-07-25): previously carried is_restatement_of_open_problem=false while its own caveat already conceded both sides were open.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Any firing endpoint certificate must satisfy 2(N + h + L + 2) < 2^L. Hence no certificate supply can be realised at bounded depth: L must grow at least logarithmically in N + h.
statement_nodes.engine: arithmetic of the two excluded boundary arcs
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Immediate from the definition (linarith); recorded as a scope fact, not a result.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Rules out only fixed-depth or sub-logarithmic-depth certificate families. It does NOT rule out depths growing like log2(N) or any faster growth, does not bound the minimal firing depth from above, and says nothing about the survivor, rank-2 or menu certificate families beyond their own analogous floors.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Once an endpoint certificate fires at depth L it fires at every deeper depth L + k. The proof uses the exact depth recurrence A(L+1) = 2A(L) + (phi(N+L+1+h) - phi(N+L+1)) together with the bound |phi(n+h) - phi(n)| <= n + h.
statement_nodes.engine: input-driven depth recurrence plus the strict totient letter bound

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Under the dyadic-room condition 2(N+h+L+2) < 2^L, the endpoint certificate at (h,N,L) holds if and only if no integer z with |z| <= N+h+L+2 is congruent to the window discrepancy modulo 2^L.
statement_nodes.engine: residue-representative bookkeeping in the interval [0, 2^L)
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: A definitional unpacking of 'residue outside a central band' into 'no small representative'.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: If the tail difference at N is an integer d, then the integer orbit c_0 = d, c_{i+1} = 2 c_i - (phi(N+i+1+h) - phi(N+i+1)) equals R_{N+i+h} - R_{N+i} for every i and is therefore trapped in the strip |c_i| < N+i+h+2 forever. Hence the decidable survivorKill certificate (every integer candidate in the initial box escapes the strip within K steps) proves the tail difference is not an integer.
statement_nodes.engine: integer carry orbit under the doubling map with totient forcing letters

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: The tail difference at period m*h telescopes into m translated period-h differences; consequently integrality of every h-difference from N0 on forces integrality of every (m*h)-difference from N0 on.
statement_nodes.engine: pure telescoping
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Any multiple of a period is a period; the base-2 form of this is classical.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: periodLcm t = lcm(1..t) is positive, is divisible by every 1 <= h <= t, satisfies t <= periodLcm t, is monotone under divisibility in t, and any strict jump periodLcm(t+1) - periodLcm t is at least periodLcm t.
statement_nodes.engine: lcm induction
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Textbook properties of lcm(1..t).

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: If for every period h >= 1 and every threshold N0 there is some N >= N0 and depth L with a firing endpoint certificate, then the #249 series is irrational.
open_antecedents: hsupply : forall h, 0 < h -> forall N0, exists N, N0 <= N and exists L, certifiedKill h N L
statement_nodes.engine: contraposition against the tail-period law
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: The corpus itself proves this hypothesis is EQUIVALENT to #249 (irrational_totient_series_iff_certificate_supply), so the implication carries no unconditional content.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: It suffices to kill, for each primitive period h0, some multiple m*h0 at arbitrarily large positions: a certificate (endpoint or survivor form) along any multiple of each primitive period implies irrationality.
open_antecedents: hsupply : forall h0, 0 < h0 -> forall N0, exists m, 0 < m and exists N, N0 <= N and exists K, survivorKill (m * h0) N K (endpoint variant: exists L, certifiedKill (m * h0) N L)
statement_nodes.engine: period-ray telescoping
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Weakens the supply obligation but the antecedent remains an unproved cofinal certificate hypothesis that implies #249; no unconditional gain.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: The whole 'for every period' obligation collapses onto the single one-parameter family h = lcm(1..t): certificates along that ray at arbitrarily large t and arbitrarily large N imply irrationality.
open_antecedents: hsupply : forall t0 N0, exists t, t0 <= t and exists N, N0 <= N and exists K, survivorKill (periodLcm t) N K (endpoint variant with certifiedKill)
statement_nodes.engine: every primitive period h0 <= t divides lcm(1..t), then multiple-period telescoping

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Both free parameters disappear: irrationality follows from the single N-indexed decidable predicate P t := 'some depth certifies (h,N) = (lcm(1..t), lcm(1..t))' holding for infinitely many t. The survivor and pure non-integrality dresses of the same diagonal hypothesis are also recorded.
open_antecedents: hsupply : forall t0, exists t, t0 <= t and exists L, certifiedKill (periodLcm t) (periodLcm t) L
statement_nodes.engine: t >= max(h0, N0) gives h0 | H_t and H_t >= t >= N0 simultaneously
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: The corpus proves this diagonal hypothesis is EQUIVALENT to #249 (irrational_totient_series_iff_lcm_diagonal_certificate_supply). The parameter reduction is a genuine reformulation of the search space, not progress on the problem.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: If the #249 series is rational then beyond some scale t1 the entire lcm cone is fractionally flat: for every t >= t1, every base multiplier q >= 1 and every step multiplier m, the difference R_{(q+m)H_t} - R_{q H_t} is an integer.
statement_nodes.engine: tail-period law plus period-ray telescoping along multiples of H_t
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Maximal spend of the rationality hypothesis on the lcm lattice; still a consequence of eventual periodicity, so its arithmetic depth is that of the classical periodicity fact.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: One certified annihilator anywhere on the two-multiplier lcm cone (h,N) = (m*H_t, q*H_t), at arbitrarily large scale, implies irrationality; the same holds with 'certificate' replaced by bare non-integrality of the cone difference. The wave-23 diagonal is the cell q = m = 1.
open_antecedents: hsupply : forall t0, exists t, t0 <= t and exists q m L, 0 < q and certifiedKill (m * periodLcm t) (q * periodLcm t) L
statement_nodes.engine: cone flatness law contradicted by one certificate
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Widest supply socket in the zone: it subsumes the diagonal, q-ray and jump lanes. Because the diagonal is a cell, the antecedent is implied by #249 as well, so this is again an equivalent reformulation rather than progress.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Certified kills at the lcm jumps (h,N) = (H_{t+1} - H_t, H_t), at arbitrarily large t, imply irrationality; jumps are the cone cells (q,m) = (1, H_{t+1}/H_t - 1) and need no side condition.
open_antecedents: hsupply : forall t0, exists t, t0 <= t and exists L, certifiedKill (periodLcm (t+1) - periodLcm t) (periodLcm t) L
statement_nodes.engine: specialisation of the cone supply through H_t | H_{t+1}
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Naming a lane, not closing one.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: A certified rank-2 residue (the second-difference window discrepancy avoiding a doubled radius-2(N+2h+L+2) band modulo 2^L) proves that (R_{N+2h} - R_{N+h}) - (R_{N+h} - R_N) is not an integer.
statement_nodes.engine: same truncation argument with three window decompositions and a doubled error band
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Structurally identical to the rank-1 soundness proof with two truncations paid for by a doubled radius.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Certified second-difference kills along the q-rays of the lcm cone, at arbitrarily large scale, imply irrationality, because cone flatness forces both first differences integral.
open_antecedents: hsupply : forall t0, exists t, t0 <= t and exists q L, 0 < q and certifiedRank2Kill (periodLcm t) (q * periodLcm t) L
statement_nodes.engine: cone flatness applied twice
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: The corpus's own measurement (rank2_kill_sound_but_not_shallower_at_cell, and a probe census) reports rank-2 is NOT shallower than rank-1, so this lane is sound but not measured as an improvement.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: For a finite menu Q of positive cone vertices at scale H and depth L, if every left endpoint P_L(q_i H) escapes some arc [P_L(q_j H), P_L(q_j H) + (q_j H + L + 2)] modulo 2^L, and each vertex satisfies the one-sided floor q H + L + 2 < 2^L, then some pair of menu vertices has a non-integral tail difference.
statement_nodes.engine: argmin over the finite menu at the vertex of minimal deep tail; no circle topology, no Helly
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: The one-sided-band accounting is a real sharpening of the two-sided pairwise band, but only measured, not proved, to be strictly stronger in general (see the single-cell witnesses).

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: If for arbitrarily large t some finite positive vertex menu on the lcm(1..t) cone fires the non-flatness certificate with its one-sided floors, then the #249 series is irrational.
open_antecedents: hsupply : forall t0, exists t, t0 <= t and exists L Q, Q <> [] and (forall q in Q, 0 < q) and (forall q in Q, q * periodLcm t + L + 2 < 2^L) and coneNonflatCert (periodLcm t) L Q
statement_nodes.engine: menu refutation against the cone flatness law
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: The antecedent is a cofinal certificate-supply hypothesis; it implies #249 and no independent evidence for it exists in the corpus. The reverse implication (that #249 forces menu firing) is NOT proved for this variant, so the hypothesis is a priori at least as strong as #249.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: The menu certificate fires if and only if the depth-L menu arcs have no common point: a firing row denies every common point by an argmin argument, and a silent row makes its own left endpoint a common point.
statement_nodes.engine: purely combinatorial argmin on residues; no analytic tails
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Turns a probe-measured gate into a theorem at every cell; both sides are finite and decidable, so nothing open is involved.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: The menu certificate is monotone in depth (given floors at the base) and monotone in the menu (a firing sub-menu keeps firing for every supermenu at the same depth, no floor needed); combining these, a small seed menu firing at its own floor lifts to every supermenu at every deeper depth.
statement_nodes.engine: halving descent for common points via the window recursion P_{L+1} = 2 P_L + phi

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Irrationality of the #249 series is EQUIVALENT to: every positive shifted tail difference being non-integral; equivalently every (h,N) admitting some certificate depth; equivalently the cofinal certificate supply; equivalently the one-parameter lcm-diagonal certificate supply. Moreover a single integral tail difference at a positive shift already makes the constant rational, since integrality of R_{N+h} - R_N is exactly integrality of 2^N (2^h - 1) S.
statement_nodes.engine: certificate completeness in the forward direction, the collapse theorems in the reverse
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is the honest audit node of the zone: it PROVES that the wave 21-24 supply hypotheses are restatements of #249, not weakenings of it. Both sides of every listed iff are open.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Every equivalence here has an open statement on BOTH sides. The zone's apparent progress (fewer parameters, one decidable predicate) is a change of coordinates on the same open problem.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: For 0 < j < 2t, if j does not divide lcm(1..t) then j is a bare prime power p^k exceeding t. Below 2t every other window index divides the period.
statement_nodes.engine: factorization comparison plus the interval argument j < 2 p^k
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Standard structure of lcm(1..t): the non-divisors just above t are exactly bare prime powers. Elementary and long known.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: If j divides H = lcm(1..t) and every prime of j still divides H/j, then phi(q H + j) = phi(j) * phi(q (H/j) + 1): the window totient on the ray splits into a known local factor and a cofactor whose argument is coprime to j.
statement_nodes.engine: multiplicativity of Euler's totient on coprime factors
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Direct application of Nat.totient_mul after observing gcd(j, q(H/j)+1) = 1.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: For a prime p <= t, p divides the cone window argument q*lcm(1..t) + s if and only if p divides the offset s.
statement_nodes.engine: p | lcm(1..t) plus Nat.dvd_add_right
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: One-line congruence; the module's own docstring says it fires no certificate.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: If q divides H then phi(qH) = q phi(H); consequently, on the whole lcm ray with 2 <= q < t, the forcing letter satisfies phi((q+1)H) - phi(qH) = phi(H) exactly.
statement_nodes.engine: strong induction on q, peeling one prime at a time with Nat.totient_mul_of_prime_of_dvd
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: phi(qH) = q phi(H) for q | H is a classical totient identity; the anchor corollary is its immediate specialisation to consecutive multiples of lcm(1..t).

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: For the dyadic coboundary a = 2c - Ec, the depth-L cleared prefix equals 2^L c_n - c_{n+L} at every start and horizon; and the coboundary class is stable under every finite iterated forward difference and every finite integer shift polynomial, with divisibility inherited and uniform bounds growing only by 2^rank (resp. by the l1 weight of the coefficients).
statement_nodes.engine: commutation of shift operators with 2 - E; induction on the shift list
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Elementary operator algebra on Z-valued sequences; shift operators commute with 2 - E because both are polynomials in E.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: The sparse pulse c_k = -A on a finite anchor set and 0 elsewhere, with letters a_i = 2 c_i - c_{i+1}, satisfies the affine binary recurrence by construction, has every letter in the ideal (A), has |c| <= |A| and |a| <= 2|A|, and at the lcm anchor set (q-1)H for 2 <= q < t with A = phi(H) it reproduces every exact whole-ray totient anchor letter phi(H).
statement_nodes.engine: synthetic sparse pulse inside the existing affineBinaryOrbit theory
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: A constructed countermodel, explicitly synthetic: the module states it does not claim the compensation letters occur as actual totient differences.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Carries NO arithmetic content about the #249 objects. sparsePulseState/sparsePulseLetter are hand-written definitions (a two-case 'if k in S then -A else 0') and the accompanying proofs are structural one-liners (ring, simp, split); the only #249-facing input is that at the lcm anchor set the letters happen to equal the true whole-ray anchor differences phi(H). Its entire mathematical value is as substrate for the barrier node barrier_finite_rank_shift_algebra, so it is classified infrastructure. Adversarial-review note (2026-07-25): reclassified from generated_certificate_instance, which was wrong - nothing here is machine-generated certificate data. That class is correctly used elsewhere in this zone only by gap_denominator_rungs, whose Farey-neighbour constants are search output.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: For every t >= 3 there is a nonzero integer carry orbit that satisfies the exact affine recurrence, absorbs every homogeneous lower factor ideal phi(j) for j | lcm(1..t), respects the natural letter bound |a_i| <= 2H + i + 1 and the strip bound |c_i| < 2H + i + 2 at every horizon, and matches every prescribed whole-ray anchor letter (lcm_factorIdeal_sparseAnchor_not_sufficient). The same orbit survives every finite integer shift polynomial: for every finite list of shift/coefficient terms the transformed pair stays a dyadic coboundary with the exact cleared-prefix identity, inherits every lower factor ideal, and obeys weight-scaled uniform bounds (lcm_factorIdeal_finiteRank_shiftAlgebra_not_sufficient). This defeats finite-rank LINEAR shift observations of any rank, not just one rank-2 or rank-3 instance; note that the shift-algebra theorem transports a strictly SHORTER property list than the rank-1 theorem (see scope_caveat).
statement_nodes.engine: sparse anchor pulse in the image of the dyadic coboundary, stable under all finite shift operators
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The barrier defeats ONLY the named hypothesis class LcmFactorIdealAnchorAdmissible: affine recurrence + homogeneous factor-ideal divisibility + the natural letter/strip bounds + the sparse whole-ray anchor values, and their images under finite integer shift polynomials (linear observations). It does NOT rule out: (i) any argument using the actual arithmetic of totient differences at NON-anchor positions (the countermodel is explicitly synthetic and does not claim its compensation letters are realisable totient differences); (ii) nonlinear combinations such as determinants of several linear observations; (iii) infinite-rank or non-shift-algebraic operators; (iv) the residual recursive quotient identity on the ray; (v) the fresh Moebius channels that survive the two-divisible-axes cancellation threshold. In particular this barrier says nothing about the endpoint/survivor/menu certificate families of this zone, which use actual totient values, not factor-ideal-only data. (vi) ASYMMETRY between the two theorems, added by adversarial review (2026-07-25): only lcm_factorIdeal_sparseAnchor_not_sufficient establishes the full LcmFactorIdealAnchorAdmissible package. The finite-rank theorem lcm_factorIdeal_finiteRank_shiftAlgebra_not_sufficient concludes strictly less about the TRANSFORMED words (d,b): it gives the coboundary property, the cleared-prefix identity, factor-ideal divisibility, and weight-scaled uniform bounds |d| <= W*phi(H), |b| <= 2W*phi(H) - but it does NOT assert the natural letter bound |b_i| <= 2H + i + 1, does NOT assert the natural strip bound |d_i| < 2H + i + 2, and carries NO anchor-matching clause for the transformed words. So a strategy that reads finite-rank shift observations and then requires those transformed observations to satisfy the natural growing strip/letter bounds or to match prescribed anchors is NOT closed by this theorem. The phrase 'closes the finite-rank shift-algebra route' must be read as: closed for strategies that need only the transported properties actually listed in the Lean conclusion. This is exactly the weaker-third-engine gap that a barrier of this shape can hide, and it is recorded here rather than left to the reader.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: The totient decomposes into Moebius divisor channels phi(n) = sum_{d|n} mu(d)(n/d), and any single channel is annihilated by two forward differences whose shift axes are both divisible by d, even with arbitrary further shifts before, between and after. Hence only channels not covered by such a divisible pair can contribute to a finite-rank shift-cube sum.
statement_nodes.engine: the d-channel becomes a constant multiple of the divisor indicator after one d-divisible shift, and the indicator is killed by a second
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Follows from the classical Moebius formula for phi and the observation that a d-divisible shift makes the channel locally affine; no converse non-vanishing claim is made, so it establishes a threshold, not an obstruction.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: The #249 constant equals no rational whose denominator divides 2^12 (2^h - 1) for some 1 <= h <= 8, and no rational whose denominator divides 2^14 (2^h - 1) for some 1 <= h <= 16. Equivalently: no dyadic rational with denominator up to 2^14, and no k/(2^a m) with a <= 14 and the multiplicative order of 2 mod m at most 16.
statement_nodes.engine: tail-period law plus a kernel-decided endpoint certificate
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is the only genuinely unconditional statement about the #249 constant in the zone, and it is weak: excluding a finite family of denominators is achievable by computing the series to sufficient precision. No claim of novelty should be attached.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Kernel-decided certificate firings and their non-integrality corollaries: endpoint kills for every h <= 8 at (N,L) = (12,16) and every h <= 16 at (14,9); a survivor kill at (1,12,7); lcm-diagonal kills at all scales t <= 8 with tabulated depths; off-diagonal cone cells at (t,q,m) = (2,3,1), (3,2,2), (3,1,3); a rank-2 kill at (1,8,9); menu refutations at (t,Q,L) = (1,[1,2,3],5), (2,[1,2,3,4],5), (3,[1,2,3],6).
statement_nodes.engine: Lean kernel decide on bounded totient tables
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: The largest scale reached is lcm(1..8) = 840 at depth 15; nothing here approaches an asymptotic statement.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Single-cell machine-checked comparisons between certificate families: the survivor certificate fires at (1,57,K=8) where every endpoint depth L <= 8 fails; rank-1 fires at (1,8,L=8) where no rank-2 certificate exists at depth <= 8 (rank-2 first fires at 9); the menu [1,3] at t=2 refutes at depth 8 where no pairwise certificate exists below depth 9; the menu [2,3,4] at t=2 refutes at depth 5 while every 2-vertex submenu and every relevant pairwise certificate is silent there.
statement_nodes.engine: Lean kernel decide at fixture cells
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: These are witnesses at ONE cell each. The accompanying census claims in the docstrings ('30 of 40 cells', '169 in the exhaustive search', '52 joint cells') are probe measurements and are NOT formalised anywhere in these modules; they must not be cited as theorems.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: If a/b < r/s < c/d with b, d > 0 and the neighbours are unimodular (bc - ad = 1), then b + d <= s.
statement_nodes.engine: s = b(cs - rd) + d(rb - as) with both bracketed factors at least 1
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: The classical mediant/Stern-Brocot gap lemma; standard Farey-sequence theory.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: For the (N=1, K) gap-certificate windows: every denominator q with 0 < q <= 248672326362367909 satisfies the K=120 gap certificate, and every q with 0 < q <= 79639646646701375323355774875831053 satisfies the K=240 one; in both cases the bound is sharp, the mediant denominator b+d being the exact first displayed failure.
statement_nodes.engine: untrusted Stern-Brocot producer emitting unimodular neighbours, checked in Lean by the mediant lemma and norm_num

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: For a reduced denominator that is a prime power p^e (e > 0), the reduced-denominator unit-gap certificate holds if and only if the candidate count L is zero, or L = 1 and p divides J+1.
statement_nodes.engine: nonunits mod p^e are the multiples of p; consecutive integers are coprime
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Elementary; both sides are finite decidable conditions.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: At an odd prime-power reduced denominator, a valid unit-gap certificate forces the candidate count to be at most 1: the unit-gap strengthening can rescue at most one lattice point over the ordinary empty-gap certificate.
statement_nodes.engine: consequence of the prime-power classification
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Applies ONLY to prime-power reduced denominators. It does not bound the candidate count for composite odd denominators with two or more distinct prime factors (where several consecutive integers can all be nonunits), does not show the unit-gap certificate fails to exist, and does not rule out the unit-gap supply hypothesis; it only shows that supply must solve a zero-or-one-candidate problem at every odd prime power as the depth grows.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Any all-denominator reduced-denominator unit-gap supply would in particular produce, for every odd prime power and every threshold, a window whose certified interval contains at most one candidate.
